signals.volume_fade: Current vol vs peak vol since entry. <30% of peak = fading. Weight: 0.20
signals.vwap_deterioration: Price below VWAP = sellers winning. >3% below = max urgency. Weight: 0.25
signals.spread_widening: Current spread vs entry spread. 3x+ widening = danger. Weight: 0.15
signals.time_decay: 0.0 before 10:30 AM ET, ramps to 1.0 at 3:00 PM. Weight: 0.15
signals.distribution: Ask size >> bid size = institutional distribution. 5x+ = max. Weight: 0.10
signals.resistance_proximity: Price near resistance = stalling. <3% away scores. Weight: 0.10
signals.failed_breakout: Price near resistance after run-up but can't break. Weight: 0.05

thresholds.EXIT: composite ≥ 0.6 → cancel limits + market sell NOW
